body.translated_text: <s>Kriyāsaṃgrahakārikā</s> (Verses on the Compendium of Ritual Actions)

children.translated_text: The examination of the <s>guru</s> (teacher) and <s>śiṣyas</s> (disciples), then the formal request to the <s>guru</s>;

children.text: mantrasevāṃ guruḥ kuryāt tato bhūmeḥ parīkṣaṇam // 1 //
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s> should perform the <s>mantrasevā</s> (mantra-practice), then the examination of the ground. (1)
Being united with <s>devatāyoga</s> (meditation on the deity) and having performed the worship of the earth,
having performed the <s>devatotthāpana</s> (invocation of the deity), one should then purify the ground. (2)

children.text: yavānāṃ ropaṇaṃ kṛtvā jāṅgulī cāpi pūjayet /
children.translated_text: Having performed the planting of barley and having also worshipped <s>Jāṅgulī</s>,
having carefully prepared the cord (<s>sūtra</s>), one should examine the <s>vāstunāga</s> (serpent-spirit of the site). (3)
Having properly ascertained the characteristics of the bricks, then the taking of the initial [direction];
having properly ascertained the measurements and costs, and the characteristics of the temple (<s>prāsāda</s>) — (4)
having worshipped the deities, the <s>dikpālas</s> (guardians of the directions), and the earth-goddesses (<s>vasudhās</s>) according to the prescribed rites,
having performed the placing of the <s>ītikā</s> (protective marker), one should perform the <s>homa</s> (fire offering) for pacification. (5)
Then the forest expedition; the wise one should properly erect the doorway;
having installed the roof-beam (<s>śirodāru</s>), one should offer into the fire of <s>amṛta</s> (nectar). (6)
The entry of the <s>vajrācārya</s> (vajra-master) into this; the meditation on the three <s>samādhis</s> (concentrations);
the laying down of the circumambulation-path cords, and also of the colored powders. (7)
The procedure of the <s>agnikriyā</s> (fire ritual), and then the installation of the <s>piṇḍikā</s> (pedestal);
having completed it with the auspicious marks, one should then install the image. (8)
The painted work, the offering-mound (<s>vali</s>), the pedestal (<s>piṇḍī</s>), then the characteristics of the <s>gaṇḍikā</s> (bell);
and the <s>pratiṣṭhāna</s> (consecration) of these, and likewise the bestowal of <s>pravrajyā</s> (ordination). (9)
The characteristics of <s>dharmadhātus</s> (relics of the teaching), the hoisting of banners;
the restoration of dilapidated [structures] and the concluding rites — one should worship the <s>gaṇamaṇḍala</s> (assembly circle). (10)

body.translated_text: The <s>Kriyāsaṃgrahakārikā</s> (Verses on the Compendium of Ritual Actions) is completed.
This is the work of the venerable <s>Nāgārjuna</s>.
